title: Onboarding Phase Assessment
description: Structured data for one weekly Onboarding Phase Assessment. The run agent EMITS this; render_phase_assessment.py turns it into HTML with phase-assessment.template.html. Plain-text fields are HTML-escaped by the generator (author them with raw &, <, >). Fields ending in `_html` are TRUSTED inline HTML inserted verbatim — that is where verbatim quotes live, wrapped in <blockquote class="oa-quote">. No styling/color decisions belong in this data.

title.description: H1, matches the md: "{Month D, YYYY} — Onboarding Phase Assessment".

source_md.description: Path of the source markdown, shown in the footer, e.g. output/2026-06-09-phase-assessment.md.

run_metadata.description: One italic appendix line: framework version, run date, data-source note.

agenda.description: The standup's three fixed buckets. Any bucket may be empty (renders "None this week").

resolve.description: Blocking items to resolve this week.

clients.description: One object per client. Order doesn't matter for correctness, but the report convention is phase ascending; sort before emitting if you want the artifact pre-sorted.

appendix.description: Maintainer notes, de-emphasized/collapsible in the artifact. Optional.

overrides.description: Override / resolution notes. Each item is trusted inline HTML (wrap identifiers in <code>).

feedback.description: Framework-feedback items. Each item is trusted inline HTML.

lead.description: Bold lead text INCLUDING its own terminal punctuation, e.g. "Lib and Co. — fix the customer import." For on-track items this is usually just the client name ("Dorell Fabrics").

detail_html.description: Rest of the line. Trusted inline HTML (may contain <span class="oa-code">).

urgent.description: At most ONE agenda item across the whole report may set this. It renders the single crimson .oa-urgent highlight (chip + rule). Resolve-bucket only, by convention.

integration.description: Exactly one mode. managed → shows an 8th "Integration" row in the Where-they-are table (needs status + what_we_see). certified → shows a one-line italic note (needs note). none → neither.

status.description: Integration build status. Required when mode = managed.

what_we_see.description: Integration-row detail. Required when mode = managed.

note.description: One informational sentence. Required when mode = certified.

label.description: Fixed label for this step number (Kickoff / First import / Building the catalog / Catalog ready / Reps using the iPad / Admin trained / Live).

status.description: Step 7 (Live) is only done or not_started.

step.description: Step number as a string ("1"–"7"), a composite span like "3/4", or "Integration".

code.description: Optional internal flag code; rendered as a muted (CODE) suffix. Use null/omit when there is no code — never use a raw code as the title. Also use null for confirmed/by-design/suppressed informational rows, AND for any flag whose code name would contradict its confirmed state (e.g. a confirmed item must not show a *_UNCONFIRMED code).

source.description: Where it's from (Fathom date / Help Scout #N / Database). Text.

said_html.description: EITHER a plain metric (text) OR verbatim quote(s) wrapped in <blockquote class="oa-quote">. Trusted inline HTML; may mix a quote then a trailing <span>.

phase_name.description: Anchor phase name (matches the step label for phase_n).

next_phase_name.description: What they're working on next (label of phase_n+1, or "Live"). Also the cohort "Working on" cell.

days.description: Days in onboarding shown in the cohort and the subline, e.g. "78" or "~320".

days_qualifier.description: Optional non-bold qualifier rendered right after "In onboarding {days} days" and BEFORE the " · " separator (e.g. " since the account was created (...)"). Default empty.

project_start_date.description: ISO date of the real project kickoff, if different from account creation. Used instead of created_at for days_in_onboarding when present.

engagement.description: Short engagement note shown after the day count (no leading separator).

one_thing.description: Cohort table: the single most important plain-English item (text).

current_step.description: The "working on" step (usually phase_n+1). Gets the gold is-current ring on the rail.

next_step.description: The card's most important line — one plain sentence (text).

flags.description: 0+ flags. When empty, the "Things to flag" block is omitted entirely.

note_html.description: Optional post-flags read/caveat — the md's free paragraph after the flags table (e.g. a 'likely routine but worth confirming' note, or an out-of-order observation). Trusted inline HTML; rendered muted between the flags table and Recent activity. Omit when absent. Use this rather than burying such commentary in a flag's said_html or bloating bottom_line.
